Rina: idea 1: 45m live with two 12-min lightning demos, one 15-min customer deep-dive, then 6m rapid-fire AMA. tight energy, clear CTA. thoughts?

Tom: yes. pick orthogonal themes: sub-50ms tail latency patterns + cost-per-inference wins. slides = 3 per demo.

Eli: customer deep-dive should be a regressed-eval story: roll back to stable model, show SLO restoration. makes it tangible.

Priya: growth ops: short form (email, company, use-case) -> webhook -> HubSpot -> tag webinar_q2_2026. add hidden field "bench_interest" for gated bench notes.

OpsBot: (auto) Set webhook retries=3 backoff=30s.

Tom: speakers: Enginfra for latency, ML infra for cost, external customer (CartaOps) for deep-dive. Eli backup.

Rina: rehearsals: individual recorded runthroughs by Fri, full dress + AV check 48h prior. fallback window: at T-1:10 host asks "demo green?" else play 60s pre-record.

Priya: upload two fallback clips per demo: 60s quick + 4m full. name: webinar_2950000000_demo1_60s.mp4 etc.

Tom: promo copy (short): "Build predictable LLM features: lightning demos + customer deep-dive. Wed, May 14. Sign up." Avoid hard cost claims in social.

LegalBot: (auto) Any benchmark claim needs dataset, model version, config. Use docs/bench-claims-template.md. SLA 48h.

Eli: will prepare bench appendix and raw logs. suggest gating appendix for registrants to boost signal.

Priya: map gated opt-in to HubSpot property bench_interest. good lead signal.

Tom: set UTMs: utm_campaign=lightning-infer_may14. Priya to implement. post-webinar routing: HubSpot -> flow -> SDR queue if score>50 else nurture. confirm SDR owner mapping before send.

Rina: run-of-show (45m):
- 00:00-02:00 Welcome + goals
- 02:00-14:00 Lightning demo 1 (latency) + 2m q
- 14:00-26:00 Lightning demo 2 (cost) + 2m q
- 26:00-41:00 Customer deep-dive + 4m q
- 41:00-47:00 Rapid-fire AMA + close + CTA

Eli: AV checkpoints: 5m before + 2m before each segment. host checklist: green/yellow/red.

Priya: timeline: registration live Mon, promos Tue, speaker pre-reads Wed, recordings due Fri, full dress Thu.

Tom: demos must run in scrubbed env with token quota <200 and fallback endpoint reachable. list endpoints in rehearsal doc.

Rina: marketing to own attendee question triage; escalate tech Qs to eng with tag "eng-answer". two slack channels during live: #webinar-ops and #webinar-live.

OpsBot: (auto) Rehearsal reminder scheduled: 2950000036 (48h prior).

Priya: uploading form + webhook config now, will post link here when done.
